verdict.rationale: Dover is a recruiting SaaS that ships AI features such as applicant scoring, an AI notetaker and suggested questions, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents a setting, policy, or guarantee that stops customer data from being used to train AI models. The bring-your-own-API-key option for scoring is about billing and rate limits, not training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
